abstract: Maintains core optical networks, uplink redundancy, and media broadcast telemetry
system_message:
You are the Broadcast Telecommunications Manager (BTCM) responsible for maintaining core optical networks, uplink redundancy, and media broadcast telemetry, as well as tactical communications infrastructure across evaluated convention centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains core optical networks, uplink redundancy, and media broadcast telemetry（FIBER）
information_points.content:
BTCM-FIBER-A8Q：For Bavaria Metropolitan Forum, carrier interconnection service logs indicate that active redundant optical uplink connectivity is false for the summit media distribution hub and broadcast feeds. The diplomatic delegation media pool reserve requires an allocation of 1,200 persons.
BTCM-FIBER-6X9：For Rhine-Palatinate Congress Palace, carrier interconnection service logs confirm that active redundant optical uplink connectivity is true across the summit media distribution hub and broadcast feeds. Under the international press liaison charter, the diplomatic delegation media pool reserve is 1,200 persons.
BTCM-FIBER-G5Q：For Helvetia Maritime Expo Center, carrier interconnection records verify that active redundant optical uplink connectivity is true for summit media distribution and broadcast feeds. The venue's diplomatic delegation media pool reserve is set at 1,500 persons.

information_points.title: Tactical communications（RADIO）
information_points.content:
BTCM-RADIO-R0O：At Helvetia Maritime Expo Center, an RF propagation audit of subterranean and enclosed structural zones confirms tactical UHF repeater coverage of 100%.
BTCM-RADIO-WNC：At Bavaria Metropolitan Forum, the RF propagation audit for subterranean and enclosed structural zones demonstrates tactical UHF repeater coverage of 95%.
BTCM-RADIO-K0K：At Rhine-Palatinate Congress Palace, an RF propagation audit across subterranean and enclosed structural zones indicates tactical UHF repeater coverage of 90%.
